'''December 2001 Greeley tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Greeley, Colorado on 1 December 2001. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from David Jones's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3144">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-timed3144/ greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-time], DeckTech (David "DavCJ" Jones, 4 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-04-greeley-co-12-1-revised-long-timed3144/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Greeley, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
